title: Evaluation Implementations
summary: This module provides a variety of evaluator implementations, ranging from base classes for individual case assessment to specialized evaluators for comprehensive report analysis. It includes tools for LLM-based judging, content verification, type checking, and statistical report generation like ROC AUC and confusion matrices.

nodes.label: BaseEvaluator
nodes.title: Base Evaluator Logic
nodes.description: Provides foundational serialization, specification building, and representation logic for all evaluator types, ensuring consistent handling of evaluator definitions.

nodes.label: Evaluator
nodes.title: Case-Level Evaluator Base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that assess individual task outputs. Subclasses implement the 'evaluate' method to perform synchronous or asynchronous evaluations.

nodes.label: ReportEvaluator
nodes.title: Report-Level Evaluator Base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that analyze full experiment reports, producing experiment-wide analyses like statistical charts or matrices.

nodes.label: LLMJudge
nodes.title: LLM-Based Judgment
nodes.description: Evaluates language model outputs against a specified rubric using another language model as a judge, optionally including input and expected output for context.

nodes.label: Contains
nodes.title: Content Containment Check
nodes.description: Checks if a task's output contains a specified value, supporting string substrings, list/tuple membership, and dictionary key-value pair presence, with optional case sensitivity.

nodes.label: IsInstance
nodes.title: Type Instance Check
nodes.description: Verifies if a task's output is an instance of a type identified by a given name, traversing the Method Resolution Order (MRO) to find a match.

nodes.label: ROCAUCEvaluator
nodes.title: ROC AUC Analysis
nodes.description: Computes the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and Area Under the Curve (AUC) from scored case data, providing insights into binary classification performance.

nodes.label: PrecisionRecallEvaluator
nodes.title: Precision-Recall Analysis
nodes.description: Calculates the precision-recall curve and its AUC from case data, useful for evaluating models on imbalanced datasets.

nodes.label: KolmogorovSmirnovEvaluator
nodes.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
nodes.description: Generates a Kolmogorov-Smirnov plot and statistic by comparing the empirical cumulative distribution functions of scores for positive and negative cases.

nodes.label: ConfusionMatrixEvaluator
nodes.title: Confusion Matrix Generation
nodes.description: Constructs a confusion matrix from predicted and expected labels extracted from case data, providing a detailed breakdown of classification results.

nodes.label: Model Providers
nodes.title: Model Providers & Wrappers
nodes.description: Provides interfaces and wrappers for various AI models and providers, enabling consistent interaction with different LLM services.

groups.label: Base Evaluator Classes
groups.title: Core Evaluator Abstractions
groups.description: Defines the foundational interfaces and common logic for all evaluation components, enabling extensibility and consistent behavior.

groups.label: Case-Level Evaluators
groups.title: Individual Case Assessment
groups.description: A collection of evaluators designed to assess the output of individual tasks or data points, providing granular feedback on performance.

groups.label: Report-Level Evaluators
groups.title: Aggregate Report Analysis
groups.description: Evaluators focused on analyzing entire evaluation reports, generating aggregate statistics, plots, and matrices to summarize overall performance.
